title: Mail-Service Rate on a Home-Delivered Fill — Prescription Insurance on File Corrected Claims
content:
A corrected fill delivered to the patient's home earns the plan's mail-service rate under **Prescription Insurance on File**. The release is read from the corrected fill's pickup record in the Prescriptions fill ledger; the delivery plan is the patient's active plan under Delivery & Pickup Services.

## Rule

- When the corrected fill was released to the patient by **home delivery** and the patient holds an **active Kestrel Mail Delivery** plan, the charge is multiplied by **0.8**.
- When the corrected fill was released by home delivery under **any other active delivery plan**, the charge is multiplied by **0.9**.
- Otherwise, including a fill collected in person, the charge is multiplied by 1.

The rate multiplies the unrounded charge; the patient pay is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Combinations

| Corrected fill released by | Patient's active delivery plan | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Home delivery | Kestrel Mail Delivery | 0.8 |
| Home delivery | Another plan, such as Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual or Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | 0.9 |
| Home delivery | None active | 1 |
| Counter, drive-thru or pickup locker | Any | 1 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A corrected fill whose pickup record shows home delivery, for a patient with an active Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery plan: the charge is multiplied by 0.9. Had the same fill been collected at the counter, no rate would apply.
